links.outcome: MLLM diagnostic accuracy under image enhancement, red-circle prompting, mismatched prompts, and repeated inference
links.effect: Red-circle prompting raised accuracy numerically in 5 of 6 model-subset comparisons; only Qwen3.8-27B in GMDB-Rare was significant (0.57% to 1.27%, adjusted P=.009). Matched vs mismatched red-circle differences had adjusted P>.05.
links.quote: Qwen3.8-27B showed a significant improvement in GMDB-Rare, with accuracy increasing from 0.57% to 1.27% (adjusted P=.009).

links.outcome: MLLM top-50 accuracy compared against a random baseline in GMDB-Rare
links.effect: In GMDB-Rare, the random baseline achieved 8.15% accuracy and exceeded all 3 models under raw image and red-circle conditions (models 0.57%-1.35%).
links.quote: In GMDB-Rare, the random baseline achieved 8.15% accuracy and exceeded all 3 models under the raw image and red-circle conditions.

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of MLLMs for rare genetic diseases from facial images
links.effect: Top-50 accuracy ranged from 13.95% to 18.25% in GMDB-Frequent and 0.57% to 1.35% in GMDB-Rare; outputs only weakly constrained by patient-specific facial information.
links.quote: Top-50 accuracy ranged from 13.95% to 18.25% in GMDB-Frequent and from 0.57% to 1.35% in GMDB-Rare.

unlisted_practices: Red-circle visual prompting of multimodal LLMs
Super-resolution image enhancement before MLLM diagnosis

screen.reason: The study empirically tests whether visual prompting (red-circle prompts) and image enhancement (super-resolution) vs raw image input improve the diagnostic accuracy of multimodal foundation models for rare genetic disease identification.
